Dear Sir/Madam,
Pursuant to Regulation 30, 33 and other applicable regulations, if any of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the company at its meeting held today i.e. on Thursday, November 12, 2026 at the registered office of the Company has inter-alia:
1. Considered and approved an Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the Half Year ended September 30, 2026
2. Considered and discussed other items as per the agenda circulated and as decided by the Board of Directors of the Company.
The meeting commenced at 04:00 P.M. and concluded at 04:35 P.M.
Enclosed herewith the copy of the financial results along with the Limited Review Report from the Auditors of the Company on an Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the Half Year ended on September 30, 2026
We request you to take the above information on your records.
